notes.title: My next game has a steam page!!!
notes.notes:
Lights End is a fast-paced hardcore first-person game where speed and aim matter. Every minor mistake can be your end, but don't give up, every replay you can improve your score and get to the final end of the loop of randomly generated levels.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2888540/Lights_End/

notes.title: Abyssal reflections can now be purchased!!!
notes.notes: Abyssal Reflections is short Atmospheric depressing "non-jumpscare" game where you go through a total of 8 different time periods. You'll have to take care of your owners and how you relate to them is up to you
